source.note: A tag opened in a frontmatter configuration value and ended in an accessible title: mermaid.js accepts the input as written and reads the accessible title as `b='c'>d`, while the specified reading keeps the `"`. The configuration of the written input does not hold the value with the `<` (mermaid.js drops it), so `embedded` records no configuration; the input with `(` for `<` would give the value `(a`.
